name: rosetta-inheritance-single
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

class Animal abstract is
    init() is si
si

class Dog: Animal abstract is
    init() is super.init() si
si

class CAT: Animal is
    init() is super.init() si
si

class LAB: Dog is
    init() is super.init() si
si

class COLLIE: Dog is
    init() is super.init() si
si

write_line("Animal <- Dog <- Lab: {isa Animal(LAB())}, {isa Dog(LAB())}")
write_line(
    "Animal <- Dog <- Collie: {isa Animal(COLLIE())}, "
    "{isa Dog(COLLIE())}")
write_line("Animal <- Cat: {isa Animal(CAT())}")
write_line("Cat is not a Dog: {!isa Dog(CAT())}")
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

class Animal abstract is
    init() is si
si

class Dog: Animal abstract is
    init() is super.init() si
si

class CAT: Animal is
    init() is super.init() si
si

class LAB: Dog is
    init() is super.init() si
si

class COLLIE: Dog is
    init() is super.init() si
si

write_line("Animal <- Dog <- Lab: {isa Animal(LAB())}, {isa Dog(LAB())}")
write_line(
    "Animal <- Dog <- Collie: {isa Animal(COLLIE())}, "
    "{isa Dog(COLLIE())}")
write_line("Animal <- Cat: {isa Animal(CAT())}")
write_line("Cat is not a Dog: {!isa Dog(CAT())}")
output:
Animal <- Dog <- Lab: True, True
Animal <- Dog <- Collie: True, True
Animal <- Cat: True
Cat is not a Dog: True
